about: Golden vectors for carts/mineswpr-logic.b4, generated from arcade mineswpr Direct by tools/gen_mineswpr_golden.gd. Grid rows: 16 strings of 16 cells, two digits per cell = armed-neighbor-count then bits (1=mine 2=cover 4=flag). sig = h=(h*31+cell+i)&0x7FFFFFFF over cells 0..255.

scenarios.name: flood-single-mine
scenarios.note: one mine: prod a zero cell uncovers everything else

scenarios.name: flood-cardinal-only
scenarios.note: PORT.md: flood spreads n/w/e/s only; (1,1) is a diagonal hint of zero cell (2,2) and stays covered

scenarios.name: diagonal-wall
scenarios.note: flood stops at a diagonal line of hints; second prod on the far side

scenarios.name: hint-prod
scenarios.note: prodding a hint cell uncovers only it

scenarios.name: flags
scenarios.note: flag+ twice counts once; flood ignores flags (uncovers, keeps bit); cannot flag uncovered; flag-; prod on flagged mine = flag- then dead

scenarios.name: prod-on-flag
scenarios.note: PORT.md: ? on a flag = flag- then prod (safe cell floods); flag- on an unflagged cell is a no-op

scenarios.name: after-game-over
scenarios.note: PORT.md: commands still work after GAME OVER

scenarios.name: flood-edges
scenarios.note: flood ( x y - ) drops out-of-range points (no row wrap); flood keeps flags and flagCount
